hook: This whole pottery-village story looks completely real, and every single frame was made by AI.
caption:
Every frame of this "documentary" is fake 🤯

A village, a river, a potter's wheel turning — it looks completely real, but none of it exists. Not the village, not the river, not the clay.

It was generated end to end with Flova AI's Script-to-Video skill and the Seedance 2.5 model. No cameras, no actors, no real clay anywhere in it.

Could you have told it was AI before we said so? 👇
